settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Everything about shipping, orders and sizing.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders arrive within 2–3 weeks. Larger or heavier orders can take a little longer.

settings.question: Is shipping free?
settings.answer: Yes. Shipping is free on every order, with no minimum spend, and every order is tracked.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose your country at the top of the page to see prices in your currency.

settings.question: When will I get my tracking number?
settings.answer: When your order ships we email your tracking number. It can take up to 48 hours to show updates. Track your order

settings.question: Do I pay customs or import tax?
settings.answer: Any customs duties or taxes charged by your country are paid by the customer.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: PayPal, Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay and major cards. Checkout is encrypted.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Email support@luxedealers.com as soon as possible with your order number and we'll do our best to help.

settings.question: Can I add a gift message?
settings.answer: Yes. Add a gift message in your bag before checkout.

settings.question: Are your items true to size?
settings.answer: Most clothing and shoes follow Asian sizing, so we recommend sizing up. See the size charts, or email us and we'll help.

settings.question: Are items checked before they ship?
settings.answer: Yes. Every order is hand-checked before it's packed.

settings.question: What if something is wrong with my order?
settings.answer: No returns needed. Email support@luxedealers.com with your order number and a photo, and we'll make it right with a refund or a free replacement. Refund policy
